scope: Bounded static method/experimental-harness review; only this review artifact written. No models, services, tests, renders, ASR or model-weight reads performed by reviewer.
method: Read reviewed methods; standard-library AST parsing, JSON/hash checks and independent simulated-coordinate calculation. Static judgments are not runtime fault-injection tests.

static_review.finding: No blocker: eight first TTS stems, untrimmed pause assembly, fixed seeded noise and zero silence match protocol. No preparation ASR/VAD selection. Artificial breath and single-sample activity bounds are explicit.

No blocker: same-room binding is immutable; task/engine ContextVar guards exclude unrelated work; original engine precedes the cancellable five-second delivery hold; warmup/whole-span retranscription excluded. Baseline transparent public chain preserves SDK bookkeeping. This controls delivery delay, not native inference speed.

No blocker in reviewed bounded paths: launch ownership, finite deadlines, condition/departure sequencing, final source check and failure-preserving cleanup match scope. Forced native/process termination remains explicitly observable, not a clean-exit claim.

No blocker: preflight snapshots methods, tested sources and eleven runtime sources; model references retained. Post checks terminal phase/census/PID state before weight reads. Full weight verification is parent-owned and was not executed by reviewer.

No blocker: memory samples cover system and owned stack processes/descendants, excluding recorder. RSS is not allocation causality. User state, pause/resume, SpeechHandle interruption and threshold PCM receipt remain separate; no-VAD controls do not prove recovery.

resolved_findings.issue: Final runner freeze failure could still complete
resolved_findings.resolution: Final errors/mismatches are retained and fail terminal success.

resolved_findings.issue: Room condition could advance while prior room remained
resolved_findings.resolution: Unverified agent departure aborts before next condition write.

resolved_findings.issue: Stale candidate-only totals and preparation wording
resolved_findings.resolution: Combined and per-arm totals and no-preparation-ASR/VAD scope now match recipes.

resolved_findings.issue: Supervisor grace shorter than bounded runner cleanup
resolved_findings.resolution: 150 seconds now exceeds active-driver plus three-service cleanup budget of 100 seconds plus monitor join.

resolved_findings.issue: ASR interruption or validation failure promoted to completed
resolved_findings.resolution: BaseException persists error; success requires complete rows, all three hash checks and clean pool shutdown.

resolved_findings.issue: Unresolved phase/PIDs did not prevent weight reads
resolved_findings.resolution: Post-verifier now raises before weights on prerequisite/source/snapshot failures.
Snapshot-manifest hash and exact source/hash census, unique paths and bytes verified.
Explicit eleven-file runtime set adds agent_session/generation/synchronizer; tested hashes rechecked while snapshots are written.

resolved_findings.issue: Input cleanup exception could leave completed status
resolved_findings.resolution: Pool failure marks failed with finished receipt; post requires finished clean generation and zero child exit.

activity_at_receipt.limit: Parent input preparation began while the final receipt was being written. This receipt must not be represented as predating first rendering; source review and resolved findings preceded receipt completion.

limits: This is readiness review, not either-arm success. Missing/unrun/failed captures, extra effects, false transcripts, trace failures and cleanup failures stay in their denominators.

Grace covers the declared cleanup waits, but abrupt supervisor SIGKILL or blocked filesystem operations can leave separate child groups or missing buffered diagnostics. Inspect actual owned-PID and escalation receipts before later inference.
Fixed arm order, shared host/cache state and one sample per condition do not establish population accuracy or causal latency benefit.
Synthetic TTS and shaped noise do not represent human breath, physical audibility or microphone echo; received ASR is a proxy, not human listening.

Existing parent/agent test receipts were source/log checked; reviewer did not rerun them. Post-inference validation is evidence integrity, not a claim that retained failed conversational trials passed.
